capabilities: Copies WhatsApp chats into vault notes
Splits notes by year, month, week or day
Prunes old days with optional TTL
Syncs on schedule or at Obsidian launch
disambiguation: Not a WhatsApp client or web bridge; it only reads the Mac app's local database and writes notes.
extras: Requires macOS Full Disk Access for all of Obsidian; notes contain other people's messages and phone numbers; fully offline, read-only; UI in Portuguese or English.
problem: WhatsApp Desktop keeps conversations in a local SQLite database that Obsidian cannot open, so chats stay outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Requer o app oficial do WhatsApp Desktop para Mac
fáceis de filtrar em Bases ou Dataview

requires.name: Official WhatsApp Desktop for Mac, opened at least once
Obsidian 1.13+ desktop from a recent installer (built-in SQLite)

summary: macOS sync plugin that copies WhatsApp Desktop chats into Obsidian notes, one folder per chat, incremental and fully local.
